title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Umami Glaze
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared snapper topped with a savory umami glaze.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the snapper fillets and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the snapper is baking, prepare the umami glaze by whisking together the umami glaze, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the umami glaze over the top of each snapper fillet.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
